scope: Exact representations for clearly evidenced form fields only; no inferred quantities, package classification, payment terms, taxes or human approval. Explicit package/PKG wording is now separately supported as PK; see docs/verified-form-normalization-sources.json (verified 2026-10-26).

sources.title: CCS4EO_VNACCS_UM V1.0
sources.locator: Printed page 25, Add goods form screenshot, quantity unit controls
sources.supports: PCE represents pieces in VNACCS quantity and invoice-price unit controls. PC, PCS, piece and pieces are explicit spelling variants. This is not a mapping from packages, sets or arbitrary units.
sources.retrieval: Public search index includes the manual's page-25 screenshot contents; direct PDF open failed. No local employee answers used.

sources.title: Recommendation 20, Codes for Units of Measure Used in International Trade
sources.locator: rec20:kilogram / rdf:value KGM; TRADE/WP.4/R.1224/Add.2 printed page 13, kilogram row
sources.supports: Explicit physical kilogram units map to KGM without numerical scaling. Package-unit KG is excluded because it can denote keg; KGS is excluded because the codebook uses it for kilogram per second.

sources.publisher: Vietnam Ministry of Finance, official Vietnam Trade Portal and Government Gazette
sources.title: Circular 38/2015/TT-BTC, Appendix II, import field 1.43
sources.locator: PDF page 13 (zero-based 12), printed page 233, section 1.43; export section 2.38 repeats the definition
sources.excerpt: “TTR”: Điện chuyển tiền (bao gồm cả “TT” và “TTr”)
sources.supports: Literal TT, TTr and telegraphic transfer correspond to TTR under this specific codebook, applicable from 1 April 2015, including 2016. No applicability claim for earlier 2015 or current rules after later amendments.
sources.activation: Helper requires explicit vnaccs-circular-38-2015 selection. Ordinary form assembly does not select a payment codebook automatically.

localGuideConflict.description: Supplied older guide describes TTR as reimbursement by telegraphic transfer and puts TT under KC. It is preserved unchanged; its difference from the official 2015 definition is explicit.
